title: Birth control consultation
what: The doctor helps you choose a way to prevent pregnancy that suits your health and lifestyle.
why: When you want protection from pregnancy, want to change methods, or after a birth or abortion.
duration: the visit usually takes 20 to 40 minutes
tell_doctor: High blood pressure, migraine, or blood clots in you or relatives
Liver disease, diabetes, or breast cancer
If you are breastfeeding, and if you plan a pregnancy soon

prepare.title: Questions
prepare.text: Think about what matters to you: convenience, long-term or short-term, effect on your periods.

prepare.title: Cycle
prepare.text: Remember the date of your last period.

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Sometimes your doctor will send you for an ultrasound or tests first.

bring: Past test and ultrasound results, if you have them
steps: The doctor asks about your health and what matters to you
Your blood pressure and weight are checked
Sometimes a pelvic exam is done
The options are explained: pills, IUD, implant, ring, condoms, and others
Together you choose the right one
The doctor explains how to start and what to do if you miss a dose
after: Start your method as your doctor said
Spotting in the first months is common and often normal
If a method does not suit you, you can change it
A follow-up visit after a few months
red_flags: Severe leg pain, swelling of one leg, chest pain, or shortness of breath: call emergency services

faq.q: Which birth control is most reliable?
faq.a: The most reliable are the IUD and the implant. But the best method is the one that suits you.
No. Only condoms protect against infections.

faq.q: Can I get pregnant after stopping?
faq.a: Usually yes. Fertility comes back. How fast depends on the method.

reminders.text: Birth control consultation tomorrow. Remember the date of your last period, and bring your medicine list.
